gaps.sentence: The bridge ___ (CLOSE) to traffic since the landslide.
gaps.hint: state continuing since a past point
gaps.explanation: 'Since' with a continuing state takes the present perfect passive: has been closed.

gaps.sentence: The debt ___ (repay) in full by May, he promised.
gaps.explanation: Reported future passive: would be + past participle after a past reporting verb.

gaps.sentence: The markings ___ (see) with the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: cannot be + seen. The context (astronomy) implies impossibility.

gaps.sentence: The castle ___ (restore) at present, so the east wing is closed to visitors.
gaps.explanation: Present continuous passive: is being + restored for work in progress now.

gaps.sentence: By the time you read this, the treaty ___ (sign) by all twelve delegations.
gaps.explanation: 'By the time + present clause' with a future meaning takes the future perfect passive.

gaps.sentence: The missing manuscripts ___ (find) — the search is officially over.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect passive: have/has been + past participle. The result matters now.

gaps.sentence: We had the whole house ___ (repaint) before the wedding.
gaps.explanation: 'Had the house repainted' — painters did it at our request. Object + past participle.

gaps.sentence: All the tickets ___ (sell) within an hour of going on sale.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: were + sold. 'All the tickets' takes a plural verb.
